comment: This traffic sign indicates the prohibition to turn in order to drive in the opposite direction. Turning left, however, is allowed. This traffic sign does not only apply to dead ends.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: I may not drive faster than 60 km/h
There is absolutely no problem in driving at 60 km/h
The recommended minimum speed is 60 km/h

correct_answers.text: I may not drive faster than 60 km/h

comment: Starting from these traffic signs a maximum of 60 km/h may be driven, regardless of the weather conditions. In bad weather conditions, the speed must be reduced further. However, the traffic sign does not say that 60 km/h must always be driven in order to stay safe. There is no traffic sign for a recommended minimum speed.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: I may only drive straight ahead
I have priority over oncoming traffic
I am on a one-way road

correct_answers.text: I may only drive straight ahead

comment: This traffic sign means "You must go straight ahead". You can only drive straight ahead and are not allowed to turn. The one-way street sign has the same colors but is rectangular.

question_text: What do you do upon seeing this traffic sign?

options.text: I approach at a moderate speed ready to brake
I allow the cross-wise moving traffic the right of way
If I am turning right, I am not obliged to wait

correct_answers.text: I approach at a moderate speed ready to brake
I allow the cross-wise moving traffic the right of way

comment: The traffic signal "Give way" signals that you are driving on a subordinate road and the cross traffic has priority. Drive slowly and stay ready to brake so that you do not miss a vehicle that is entitled to drive.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: A bridle-path, which riders are required to use
A bridle-path, which may not be used by other road users
A path, which may not be used by riders

correct_answers.text: A bridle-path, which riders are required to use
A bridle-path, which may not be used by other road users

comment: This traffic sign shows you a riding path. Here riders move with their horses. Other road users are not allowed to use this path.

question_text: What must you do upon seeing this traffic sign?

options.text: - stop and give way
- stop only if there is a stop line
- stop only if there is cross-wise moving traffic

correct_answers.text: - stop and give way

comment: The sign "Stop! Yield to cross traffic" requires you to stop and thereby slow down the vehicle to a complete stop. It doesn't matter if there is a stop line or if cross traffic is coming.

question_text: What do you have to do in this traffic situation?

options.text: - stop at the line of sight and give way
- not stop, because there is no stop line
- stop only if there is cross-wise moving traffic

correct_answers.text: - stop at the line of sight and give way

comment: At the traffic sign "Stop! Yield to cross traffic" you have to stop and give way. You always have to stop, even if there is no cross traffic. Since there is no stop line, stop at the line of sight. From the line of sight, you can see the street you want to enter.

question_text: What do you have to do in this traffic situation?

options.text: - stop at the stop line and give way
- stop only at the stop sign
- stop only if there is cross-wise moving traffic

correct_answers.text: - stop at the stop line and give way

comment: The traffic sign "Stop! Yield to cross traffic!" requires that you stop and give way. Since there is a stop line, you must stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, you must stop at the line of sight and your wheels have to stop completely. You always have to stop, even if there is no cross traffic.

question_text: You are driving along a priority road. Which traffic sign ends your right of way?
comment: Example 1 means "Yield", you must give priority to other road users. Sign 2 grants you right of way at the next intersection. Sign 3 only warns of a danger zone.

question_text: What do you have to be aware of with this traffic sign?

options.text: I have to signal a left-turn
I may only continue driving by taking a left turn
I may not signal

correct_answers.text: I have to signal a left-turn
I may only continue driving by taking a left turn

comment: This traffic sign regulates the direction of travel. You may only turn left here. The change of the direction of travel must be indicated.

question_text: What applies with this traffic sign?

options.text: I have to drive past obstructions on the left
I am obliged to turn left
I may not turn right before the sign

correct_answers.text: I have to drive past obstructions on the left

comment: This traffic sign prescribes from which side you have to circuit the obstacle. You can find the regulation sign at central, stop islands or construction sites. If you meet the sign at an intersection or T-junction, you may turn in the appropriate direction.

question_text: What applies in the area 15 m in front of and behind this traffic sign?

options.text: - stop
- not obstruct passengers boarding or alighting
- park

correct_answers.text: - stop
- not obstruct passengers boarding or alighting

comment: At the traffic sign you can see that there is a tram or bus stop here. 15 meters before and after the traffic sign, drivers are not allowed to park their vehicles. Unless public transport is impeded or passengers are endangered, waiting is allowed for up to three minutes.

question_text: What applies with this traffic sign?

options.text: I have to signal a right-turn
I may only continue driving by taking a right turn
I may also continue driving by taking a left turn

correct_answers.text: I have to signal a right-turn
I may only continue driving by taking a right turn

comment: The given direction of travel is binding. The car driver must turn right before the traffic sign and indicate this process to other road users.

question_text: What applies with this traffic sign?

options.text: I have to anticipate taxi moving off and coming to a stop
I may stop
I may park

correct_answers.text: I have to anticipate taxi moving off and coming to a stop

comment: The traffic sign indicates a taxi stand. There is basically a stopping restriction for all other vehicles. The car driver must always expect departing and arriving taxis and passengers in this area.

question_text: What does this traffic sign combination indicate?

options.text: - may be used by winter sports enthusiasts
- may not be used by traffic in winter
- may only be used with snow chains

correct_answers.text: - may be used by winter sports enthusiasts

comment: This sign means "Danger zone" and the additional sign stands for "Winter sports allowed". The combination indicates that winter sportspersons may use the road and road users must pay particular attention to it.

question_text: What do you have to be aware of in this traffic situation?

options.text: - not cross the lane marking
- cross the lane marking in order to overtake
- cross the lane marking if oncoming traffic permits this

correct_answers.text: - not cross the lane marking

comment: You must not drive over the lane boundary (solid line) to the left, which is located at the middle of the lane. Driving on it is also prohibited.

question_text: What must you be aware of on this priority road?

options.text: Parking is prohibited
You may not cross the lane marking
Parking is permitted if there is a clear space of at least 3 m between a parked car and the lane marking

correct_answers.text: Parking is prohibited
You may not cross the lane marking

comment: The solid line in the middle between the two lanes prohibits crossing or crossing this line. It also prohibits parking on priority roads outside of built-up areas.

question_text: You want to overtake. What is the right thing to do?

options.text: - overtake
- not overtake
- only overtake, if I remain in the right-hand lane while doing so

correct_answers.text: - overtake

comment: You may overtake if other road users are not endangered. The one-sided lane boundary allows you to cross the two lines from the side where the broken line is located.

question_text: As a resident, you want to drive into a cycle highway that has this sign. What must you be aware of when doing so?

options.text: Vehicles may not be driven faster than 30 km/h
Cycles may travel alongside one another
Cycle traffic may not be impeded

correct_answers.text: Vehicles may not be driven faster than 30 km/h
Cycles may travel alongside one another
Cycle traffic may not be impeded

comment: A maximum speed of 30 km/h applies to traffic. Cycling traffic must not be endangered or obstructed. If necessary, motor vehicle traffic must reduce speed further. Side-by-side cycling is permitted.

question_text: Who may enter a street that has this sign?

options.text: All cyclists
All persons visiting residents
All moped riders

correct_answers.text: All cyclists
All persons visiting residents

comment: Vehicular traffic other than cyclists may not use cycle lanes unless permitted by additional sign. The additional sign allows residents to enter the bicycle lane.

question_text: This road traffic sign is displayed for your lane. What must you be aware of?

options.text: I must drive at a minimum speed of 60 km/h, if permitted by the road and traffic conditions
I may only use this lane if my vehicle can and is allowed to drive at a speed of least 60 km/h
I may not drive faster than 60 km/h

correct_answers.text: I must drive at a minimum speed of 60 km/h, if permitted by the road and traffic conditions
I may only use this lane if my vehicle can and is allowed to drive at a speed of least 60 km/h

comment: This traffic sign indicates the prescribed minimum speed. You must therefore drive at least 60 km/h, provided that the road and traffic conditions allow it.

question_text: What is the maximum speed a vehicle may drive in a zone with this sign?
comment: Cyclists, light electric vehicles and other authorized vehicles may not drive more than 30 km/h in bicycle zones.

question_text: What situation applies according to this traffic sign?

options.text: - applies between 10 pm and 6 am
- applies between 6 am and 10 pm
- does not apply to electric vehicles

correct_answers.text: - applies between 10 pm and 6 am

comment: The additional sign limits the speed limit between 10 pm and 6 am.

question_text: What should you do when you see this road sign?

options.text: - indicate left
- turn left before the traffic sign
- turn left behind the traffic sign

correct_answers.text: - indicate left
- turn left before the traffic sign

comment:
The arrow on this traffic sign always shows the direction of travel. If it is a straight arrow, you have to turn in front of the sign. If it is a curved arrow, you must turn according to the sign. 
You have to flash to indicate the change in driving direction.

question_text: Which road sign indicates that turning around is not allowed?
comment:
All traffic signs show you that turning is prohibited.

The traffic sign tells you that a tunnel begins here. Turning is strictly prohibited in the tunnel.

The traffic sign “Turning Prohibited” shows you that turning is prohibited here.

This traffic sign tells you that you are on a highway. U-turns are strictly prohibited on the highway.

question_text: From which road sign onwards may you not exceed a permissible maximum speed of 60 km/h?
comment:
Traffic signs with a red border generally indicate a ban.
On a road with such a traffic sign you are not allowed to exceed the maximum permitted speed of 60 km/h.
